Maya (CSM): Heads-up: KryptonWare renewal ~6w. Usage down ~48% last 30d, embeddings & rerank worst. Heard whispers of a NebulaAI POC. Need quick triage.
Jordan (AM): Any clear trigger? recent deploys or billing?
Maya (CSM): They rotated keys 2024-11-02 and flipped a custom router. Multiple inactive seats.
Devon (SE): Logs show 502s and elevated tail latency on /embed since the rotation. Snippet: ERROR 502 gateway timeout route=/embed.
Luca (AE): I'll reach procurement. Can we propose short Dedicated trial to stall vendor switch?
Ana (Rev Exec): We can, but want engineering mitigation first and a one-pager comparing latency/cost vs NebulaAI.
Devon (SE): Low-risk mitigation: enable prefix KV caching + bump concurrency to 1.5x for 72h. I can push an account override and run a smoke test.
Maya (CSM): Perfect. Jordan—export top routes + seat activity by EOD. Luca—prep a concise commercial offer. I'll draft the invite for a quick exec+tech call.
AlertBot: Reminder: KryptonWare enablement session scheduled 2024-11-05 16:00 PT.
Jordan (AM): Export uploaded: https://redwood.example.com/internal/exports/kryptonware_1753214321.csv (internal).
Devon (SE): Override staged in prod. Validation curl: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer prod-krypton' https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/embed -d '{"input":"test"}'. Tail latency now < 400ms on sample run.
Maya (CSM): Great. Agenda for call: current state, mitigation demo, success metrics, next steps. If no engagement in 72h, escalate to RevOps for an exec outreach.
Luca (AE): Scheduling two slots and sending invites to Priya (Dir Data), Evan (Procure), their Eng lead, and Ana.
Maya (CSM): Thanks everyone. Reconvene after the call to decide on trial credits.
